messages:
Sam: FYI — AcmeCorp POC failing during structured output parsing. Customer sees JSON parse errors in their client.
Maya: Ugh. Which endpoint/path?
Sam: /v1/generate -> using tool_calls enabled + json_mode. They say the payload sometimes has trailing text after the JSON object. Happens intermittently under load.
Liam: Confirming from Acme: the SDK throws 'Unexpected token' when trying JSON.parse(resp.output). We see a pattern — valid JSON then a newline and 'Done.' appended.
Maya: @Ravi can you check runtime logs for that session? Might be the streaming chunk flush adding a footer.
Ravi: Looking now. I can repro locally with a simulated burst of 60 concurrent requests. I see the final chunk contains:
```
{"result": {"items": 3}}
Done.
```
Ravi: That "Done." is coming from an older helper in the tool adapter that prints status to the stream. Shouldn't be in response body.
Sam: That matches customer traces. They hit it twice in 2 hours and then got a 429 on retries.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: service/runtime v2.14.1 -> v2.14.2 by @ravi (cherry-pick fix).
Maya: Any mitigation we can tell the customer right now? They asked about Dedicated pricing if we can't guarantee stability.
Ravi: Short term: instruct them to use the SDK option 'tolerate_trailing( true )' — there's a flag in our client to strip non-JSON suffixes. I'll push a hotfix to remove the stray print in runtime.
Jo: On the security questionnaire: Acme asked about logs retention and KMS. We need to provide the policy doc — retention is 30 days by default for hosted, can be configured for Dedicated. KMS: we support customer-managed keys for Private and Dedicated + HSM integration for enterprise.
Maya: Sam — can you confirm Acme's expected SLO? They mentioned strict parsing guarantees and 99.9% uptime.
Sam: They're looking for deterministic JSON output and a plan for rate limit/backoff. Also want a pricing estimate for a 4-week Dedicated POC.
Maya: I'll draft a quick quote and include expedited onboarding + 24/7 support add-on. Sam, add their expected QPS and any compliance asks to the doc.
Liam: Customer is okay to try the SDK workaround for now. They want the fix timeline.
Ravi: Hotfix queued, aiming for a 2-hour rollback window. Will post release hash and logs link once live.
Sam: Thanks team. I'll update Acme and include Jo's KMS/retention bullet points. Please post the fix hash here when done. :thumbsup:
